pretreatment: Thermal pre-treatment of the silica support was carried out with air in a muffle furnace at 600 °C for 16 h. The support was further heated in a flow of dry nitrogen at 180 or 450 °C immediately before the chemisorption of the precursor.
evidence: The catalysts were prepared by chemisorption of cobalt(III)acetylacetonate Co(acac)3 from the gas phase onto silica (Silica Grace 432). Thermal pre-treatment of the silica support was carried out with air in a muffle furnace at 600 °C for 16 h. The support was further heated in a flow of dry nitrogen at 180 or 450 °C immediately before the chemisorption of the precursor.
